calls.statement:
SELECT 
  fiscal_year, 
  fiscal_period, 
  fiscal_quarter,
  fiscal_period_label,
  period_start_date, 
  period_end_date,
  weeks_in_period,
  fully_loaded
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  p.category,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name, p.category
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag = true THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_purchase_units,
  SUM(quantity) AS total_units,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag = true THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) / SUM(quantity), 2) AS staff_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5

SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned,
  SUM(f.quantity) - COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_returned), 0) AS net_units,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_returned), 0) / SUM(f.quantity), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5

SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  p.category,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = false
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name, p.category
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 10
